goal: Avoid fee estimation errors and severe underestimation when the mempool estimator is not ready
Ensure the combined fee estimator falls back to block policy instead of failing or defaulting to the floor
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate review now
agreement: Broad support for falling back to block policy instead of surfacing errors (achow101, stickies-v)
Verified that the change resolves the estimation failure in testing (tankyleo)
Code approvals after iterative fixes (willcl-ark, polespinasa)
Contested objection: falling back during starved mempools risks fee overestimation (davidgumberg)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it prevents severe fee underestimation when the mempool is sparse or missing
avoids unnecessary errors for RPC fee callers by falling back to valid block policy estimates
resolves a practical issue reported by downstream projects like LDK
